translation:
Title: [Graduate School] Interview and Oral Examination Schedule for the 2027 Graduate Early-Round Admission (Friday, October 16)

The interview and oral examination schedule for Aerospace Engineering in the 2027 graduate early-round admission (전기모집) is as follows.

What to bring: admission ticket (수험표) and identification

Issue of admission tickets
From Tuesday, October 6, 2026, applicants may print their own admission ticket from the application website. (You must bring the admission ticket on the interview day.)

Interview and oral examination schedule

[Master's applicants]
- Waiting room entry: entry must be completed by 8:30 a.m. on Friday, October 16, 2026. No entry after 08:30.
- Waiting room: Building 301, Room 1313
- Master's applicants move to the problem-solving room from 9:03 a.m. (each applicant solves problems for 20 minutes, followed by a 10-minute oral examination and interview).

[Integrated master's-doctoral and doctoral applicants]
- Waiting room entry: entry must be completed by 9:50 a.m. on Friday, October 16, 2026. No entry after 09:50.
- Waiting room: Building 301, Room 1355-2
- Doctoral and integrated master's-doctoral applicants move to the interview room from 10:45 a.m. (interview of about 5 minutes).
* Master's interviews will be in progress when you enter, so please move quietly.

Master's oral examination (only for applicants to the master's program in Aerospace Engineering)
- On the day, each applicant reviews the problems for 5 subjects, selects 2 subjects and solves the problems for 20 minutes, followed by a 10-minute oral examination and interview.
- Exam scope: see the attached file.

Attachment (1): (붙임 3). 27학년도 대학원 전기 모집 구술고사(석사과정) 범위.hwp (51 KB) [Attachment 3: Scope of the oral examination (master's program), 2027 graduate early-round admission]. The content of this attachment was not included in the notice text and was not read.
